test_specs.name: Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure
assertions: POSITIVE: Successfully report outcome to circuit breaker when sse stream encounters mid-flight reset
NEGATIVE: Ensure sse stream truncation does not bypass circuit breaker failure logging

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Backend socket reset or timeout
assertions: POSITIVE: Emit error sse event when backend socket resets
NEGATIVE: Do not leave sse stream open when backend socket times out

test_specs.name: Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential
assertions: POSITIVE: Resolve auth key successfully using readCredential in authenv
NEGATIVE: Do not directly read process.env in authenv without calling readCredential

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Missing or invalid credential
assertions: POSITIVE: Handle missing credential in obl-backend-auth-fail-1 by raising unauthenticated error
NEGATIVE: Do not issue unauthenticated request upstream when obl-backend-auth-fail-1 credential is missing

test_specs.name: Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching
assertions: POSITIVE: Parse @relay: directives successfully from user text blocks in obl-config-routing-inv-1
NEGATIVE: Do not parse @relay: directives from injected file contents in obl-config-routing-inv-1

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Invalid configuration format
assertions: POSITIVE: Raise routingerror when configuration format is invalid
NEGATIVE: Do not fall back to default routing on invalid routingerror configuration

test_specs.name: SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes
assertions: POSITIVE: Quote backslash characters correctly in cli shell argument rendering
NEGATIVE: Do not leave backslashes unquoted in cli argument output

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Unknown command or invalid flag options
assertions: POSITIVE: Reject unknown command in obl-cli-tools-fail-1 with exit code
NEGATIVE: Do not execute mutating operations for unknown options in obl-cli-tools-fail-1
